title: Signal Match Key
description: Key that an onboarder matches records on, such as email or mobile_id.
x-deprecated-enum-values-doc: Deprecated in 3.3 and removed in 4.0 (#8791): `name` collides with the enum member protocol in Python and Java (`Enum.name`). Use `full_name`. Receivers accept both values through 3.x. Send the replacement only when the release served is 3.3 or later; a 3.2 receiver treats it as an unknown value. A published file, such as `adagents.json`, keeps the original through 3.x.
